```{r load data}

relsize$country       <- gsub("USA", "United States", relsize$country)
s$region              <- gsub("USA", "United States", s$region )
```

```{r richness and diversity update}

merged_df <- BA1BA2 %>%
  left_join(diversity_df, by = c("country" = "location", "Day" = "week"))
  
# Replace the columns in BA1BA2 with the values from diversity_df
BA1BA2$richness <- merged_df$richness.y

  left_join(diversity_df, by = c("country" = "location", "Day" = "week"))
```

```{r days from last peak}
# Start of each country's window: the 5th row of its five weeks (t-4)
rowIndices <- seq(from = 5, to = 220, by = 5)
startDates <- function(df) setNames(as.Date(df[rowIndices, "Day"]), df[rowIndices, "country"])
BA1_start_date <- startDates(DeltaBA1)
BA2_start_date <- startDates(BA1BA2)

# Days from the last wave peak before the start date, looked up by country name
daysFromLastPeak <- function(start_dates) {
  sapply(names(start_dates), function(location) {
    peaks <- as.Date(wave_metrics$wave_peak[wave_metrics$location == location])
    peaks <- peaks[peaks < start_dates[[location]]]
    if (length(peaks) == 0) NA else as.numeric(start_dates[[location]] - max(peaks))
  })
}
DeltaBA1$days_from_last_peak <- unname(daysFromLastPeak(BA1_start_date)[DeltaBA1$country])
BA1BA2$days_from_last_peak   <- unname(daysFromLastPeak(BA2_start_date)[BA1BA2$country])
```

```{r genetic distance}
addgendist <- function(df, gendist) {
  g <- gendist %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = segment, values_from = test_unique_mean) %>%
  rename(s_gene = S)
  df$s_gene <- g$s_gene[match(df$country, g$country)]
  df$total  <- g$total[match(df$country, g$country)]
  df
}

DeltaBA1 <- addgendist(DeltaBA1, gendist_BA1)
BA1BA2 <- addgendist(BA1BA2, gendist_BA2)
```

```{r imputation}
performImputation <- function(dataFrame, targetColumn, numImputations, clusterCol) {
  # Ensure the cluster column is a factor
  dataFrame[[clusterCol]] <- as.factor(dataFrame[[clusterCol]])

  # Replace problematic characters in column names
  names(dataFrame) <- make.names(names(dataFrame))

  # Identifying columns with missing values, excluding the target column
  naCols <- setdiff(names(dataFrame)[sapply(dataFrame, function(x) any(is.na(x)))], targetColumn)

  # Subset the dataframe for imputation, excluding the target column
  subsetDataFrame <- dataFrame[, naCols]

  # Perform imputation using 'pmm' (predictive mean matching), excluding the target column
  imputedData <- mice(subsetDataFrame, m = numImputations, method = 'pmm', printFlag = FALSE)
  
  # Create a list to store imputed data frames
  imputedDataList <- vector("list", numImputations)

  # Loop through each imputed dataset
  for (i in 1:numImputations) {
    # Obtain complete data for each imputation
    tempImputedData <- complete(imputedData, action = i)
    # Combine original data and imputed data, excluding the target column from being overwritten
    tempDataFrame <- dataFrame
    tempDataFrame[, naCols] <- tempImputedData[, naCols]
    # Store in the list
    imputedDataList[[i]] <- tempDataFrame
  }

  return(imputedDataList)
}

set.seed(123)

if (params$analysis != "dynamic") {
  DeltaBA1 <- performImputation(DeltaBA1, "relsize", 30, "country")
}
BA1BA2 <- performImputation(BA1BA2, "relsize", 30, "country")
```

```{r categorical variables preprocessing}
createDummyVariable <- function(dataFrame, columnName) {
  # Convert the specified column to a factor
  dataFrame[[columnName]] <- factor(dataFrame[[columnName]])
  # Construct the formula
  formulaString <- paste("~", columnName, "- 1")
  formulaObject <- as.formula(formulaString)
  # Create dummy variables
  dummyVars <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(formulaObject, dataFrame))
  # Bind the dummy variables to the original DataFrame
  dataFrame <- cbind(dataFrame, dummyVars)
  # Remove the original column
  dataFrame[[columnName]] <- NULL
  return(dataFrame)
}

applyDummyVariablesToList <- function(dataList, columnName) {
  lapply(dataList, createDummyVariable, columnName = columnName)
}


if (params$analysis != "dynamic") {
  DeltaBA1 <- applyDummyVariablesToList(DeltaBA1, "Season")
}
BA1BA2 <- applyDummyVariablesToList(BA1BA2, "Season")
```

```{r LOOCV RF}
leaveOneCountryOutCV <- function(imputedDataList) {
  uniqueCountries <- unique(imputedDataList[[1]]$country)  
  results <- list()

  for (country in uniqueCountries) {
    # Initialize an empty list to store predictions for each imputed dataset
    allPredictions <- list()
    featureImportances <- list()

    # Iterate over each imputed dataset
    for (dataFrame in imputedDataList) {
      # Split data into training (all but one country) and testing (one country)
      trainData <- dataFrame[dataFrame$country != country, ]
      testData <- dataFrame[dataFrame$country == country, ]

      # Train the model on training data
      model <- randomForest(relsize ~ . - country, data = trainData, 
                            importance = TRUE, ntree = 10000)

      # Make predictions on test data
      allPredictions[[length(allPredictions) + 1]] <- predict(model, newdata = testData)
      
      # Store feature importance
      featureImportances[[length(featureImportances) + 1]] <- importance(model)
    }

    # Combine results
    resultsPerImputation <- lapply(allPredictions, function(preds) {
      data.frame(predictions = preds)
    })
    
    # Aggregate predictions across all imputations
    aggregatedPredictions <- rowMeans(do.call(cbind, allPredictions))
    
    # Calculate the mean of the 5 points in aggregatedPredictions
    overalMean <- mean(aggregatedPredictions)
    
    # Aggregate feature importance across all imputations
    aggregatedImportance <- Reduce("+", featureImportances) / length(featureImportances)
    
    
    # Store all results
    results[[country]] <- list(actuals = testData$relsize,
                               overalMean = overalMean,
                               perImputation = resultsPerImputation, 
                               aggregated = aggregatedPredictions,
                               featureImportance = aggregatedImportance)
  }

  return(results)
}


if (params$analysis != "dynamic") {
  resultsLOOCVDeltaBA1 <- leaveOneCountryOutCV(DeltaBA1)
}
resultsLOOCVBA1BA2 <- leaveOneCountryOutCV(BA1BA2)
```
